contract.title: Authoritative Finding Context and Risk Readiness Vertical Slice
acceptance_criteria: Execution changes only the exact thirteen allowed paths and Scope Guard reports COMPLIANT; no wildcard or implicit scope expansion is permitted.

The read-only application projection reuses FindingsQueryService and the existing Finding AssetContext Threat Intelligence correlation Evidence provenance RiskAssessmentReadinessService and RiskReadinessService boundaries without introducing a parallel risk or scoring engine.
Application projection contracts are placed in application/finding_risk_context.py and transport-only Pydantic response contracts remain in api_app.py according to existing repository conventions.

GET /api/findings/{finding_id}/risk-context returns source facts asset resolution threat-intelligence applicability and completeness correlation evidence evidence readiness risk inputs missing requirements and risk assessment as separately typed sections.
Every authoritative Finding fact preserves a stable fact name value and non-empty source reference; scanner facts are not reinterpreted as business or environmental facts.

Asset resolution preserves resolved not_found and missing_identifier states; resolved context retains identifier type and value canonical asset ID criticality and exact source reference while unresolved context contains no placeholder identity or criticality.

Threat Intelligence preserves Finding-to-CVE applicability and each fact completeness state source type and source reference; unavailable timeout not-found invalid-source and not-applicable conditions remain explicit and are never converted to false zero or a risk conclusion.

Canonical derived Evidence preserves identifier kind type contract version provenance and all input references; missing evidence preserves correlation completeness provenance and missing requirements.
Evidence readiness and risk assessment readiness remain semantically distinct; evidence READY never implies that required risk inputs are complete or that a score is authorized.

All required risk inputs are enumerated as exactly AUTHORITATIVE UNKNOWN or NOT_EVALUATED; authoritative values include their source and unavailable values contain neither fabricated values nor fabricated sources.

INSUFFICIENT_CONTEXT always returns score null priority null business_impact null decision null and an empty recommendations collection with refusal reasons derived from actual missing input states and evidence requirements.

The implementation never calls PredatorEngine.run /api/decisions DecisionEngine BusinessContextEngine BusinessImpactBuilder RecommendationEngine RecommendationBuilder either legacy RiskEngine directly or any AI provider.

The implementation does not infer or fabricate business service environment owner production status data sensitivity dependency impact risk appetite control effectiveness score priority recommendation cost effort risk reduction confidence target time management conclusion or approval state.
Greenbone default false UNKNOWN and null fields are not promoted into evaluated exposure detection threat-intelligence-match MITRE business-context or risk facts.
The configured DistCC Finding 6d3167e9-002c-4b76-a5a7-ce47f81b78b1 with CVE-2004-2687 is an acceptance scenario only; production logic does not branch on its ID IP CVE title or expected criticality.

The existing selected-Finding lifecycle is extended with an explicit risk-context load action and controlled Loading Error and Success states; stale responses are suppressed and state resets when selection changes.

The Finding Detail UI separately renders known authoritative facts and their source references missing risk inputs evidence requirements and an explicit fail-closed refusal explanation without client-side risk or business arithmetic.
The UI visibly answers what PredatorAI knows where each authoritative fact came from what remains missing and why risk priority business impact decision and recommendation are withheld.
Unknown Finding returns 404 and missing source configuration retains 503 semantics; integrity and configured-source failures fail closed without a partially complete claim.

Focused application tests cover resolved unresolved and missing-identifier assets TI applicable not-applicable incomplete and unavailable states evidence provenance risk input states missing requirements and scoreless insufficient context.
Focused API tests cover typed success 404 503 source failure integrity failure TI availability distinctions and prove no legacy decision or AI execution path is invoked.

Focused frontend tests validate the complete response shape contradictory state rejection loading error success selection reset stale suppression source rendering missing requirements explicit refusal and absence of fabricated result fields.
Existing Finding query AssetContext Finding-asset TI observation correlation risk-readiness Finding Explainability linked-Incident SOC route and cross-workspace regressions remain passing.

Python tests full frontend regression TypeScript production build and git diff --check pass; direct Architect review verifies truthfulness provenance non-invocation and exact scope beyond generic green validators.
Product Owner live acceptance demonstrates the configured DistCC Finding with real source references explicit missing context and a truthful refusal to calculate risk priority or recommendation.
Do not transition TASK-0127 to DONE and do not create TASK-0128.
